transcript.content: When did the abdominal pain start and how would you describe its character?

It started about 16 hours ago, right after I was discharged from the hospital. The pain feels sharp and intense, centered around my belly button, and it’s been constant since it began. It’s not getting better or worse, just staying severe.
Do you have any nausea, vomiting, fever, or changes in bowel movements?
No nausea or vomiting. I have had bloody loose bowel movements, but no fever. The pain is still severe and hasn't changed.
Can you tell me about any recent surgeries, hospitalizations, or underlying medical conditions you have?

I was in the hospital for a heart attack last week, so that was a recent hospitalization. I haven’t had any surgeries recently. I’ve had diabetes for about 35 years and high blood pressure for 20 years. I also smoke a lot.

transcript.content: When did your joint pain first start, and which joints are affected?

It started about six years ago, mainly in my left big toe. Over time the pain spread to my hips and both knees, getting worse when I walk or stand and easing when I sit or lie down. I haven’t noticed any other aches or symptoms.
Do you have any swelling, redness, or warmth in the affected joints?
No, I don’t see any swelling, redness or warmth in the joints. They just hurt.
